title: FREE RPG Maker XP on Steam to use AI assets on.
author: DarkJayson

comments.author: DarkJayson
comments.body:
The reason I am posting this is because the RPG maker series is great engine to use AI game assets on, while its good to get Ai assets or develop them you need something to use them on and this is a free copy of RPG maker XP while not the latest version its still a good one.

Its only free for a limited time so grab it when you can.

One last tip not only can you generate images and textures and other assets but because it has been around for so long ChatGPT and bard/Gemini or what ever google is now calling it knows a lot about the engine and its scripting language so if you get stuck just ask them, just be careful of any hallucinations I personally use both to double check each others work.

Have fun.

replies.author: Tom_Corvus5
replies.body: Please, how can I connect AI assets to RPG Maker XP?

replies.author: DarkJayson
replies.body:
You do not connect them as such, RPG Maker XP assets are simple files such as image files or spite sheets which are simply a collection of small images of a certain size showing frames of an animation such as a character walking the engine displays each image in a sequence and it looks like its animated.

Music and sounds are just ordinary sound files.

What you need to do is first learn what the RPG Maker XP normal assets are and how there formatted as that is important and then look up how to make them in an AI generator be it an image or sound generator.

Those generated assets can then be used in RPG Maker XP like normal assets.

replies.author: Tom_Corvus5
replies.body: That is what I thought. But can you generate things such as scripts?

replies.author: DarkJayson
replies.body:
Yes it can as RPG Maker XP is quite old so it a lot of the llms like chatgpt and others have knowledge of them BUT there not perfect and you will have to learn how the scripts work and what they can and can not do because the llms do make stuff up now and again.

Also they can not think for themselves you need to be able to think of what you want done and explain it dont ever assume they can guess what you mean.

Also you can feed back what they wrote back to themselves and ask them if there are any problems with it and ask them to fix it or even feed the results into other llms and ask them to review what was wrote and improve it and then feed that back into something else.

But the main thing is to keep learning how the scripting works so the llms can work with you rather than for you.
